question: Which hormone helps the body to adjust to stress when one is very angry, embarrassed or worried?
solution:
The correct answer is __Adrenalin__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Adrenalin 

 
 
• Adrenalin helps the body to adjust to stress when one is very angry, embarrassed, or worried.
 
• Adrenaline, also known as epinephrine, is a hormone and medication involved in regulating visceral functions (e.g., respiration).
 
• It appears as a white microcrystalline granule. Adrenaline is usually produced by the adrenal glands and by a small number of neurons in the medulla oblongata.
